qualification: Instrumented temporary host copies, real WebView2, not final productive certification. Additional private metadata binding and synchronous trace I/O may affect timing. Metadata order is HOST_RECEIPT order, not proof of engine emission time.

cases.observation: Two input-length progressions 1..42; at sequence 241 current falls from 42 to 1 in the same live world, then reaches 42 again before pagehide. This is observed receipt ordering, not proof of a late post-retire event or historical cause.
cases.history: History cases execute BACK/FORWARD only after successful takeover_end. The historical failure preceded those actions; the history label is not proof that back/forward caused takeover_end failure.

ownership.staticBinding: One registry owned by WebView2Runtime/BrowserSession; all owned Page ObservationRuntime instances share that registry. Control key = host-owned Page identity + CDP executionContextId + per-world WeakMap opaque control counter.
ownership.observed: Each control alias remains in exactly one page/world in these executions; no received values for retired worlds, and each frame selection has exactly one protected world. Host/session aliases are trace-local, disambiguated by host PID.
ownership.limitations: No rejected execution was captured. These bounded observations do not prove universal CDP context-ID nonreuse or exclusion of every navigation race.
